description: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category slug, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each result. Use it when the user asks which AI tool does something. `matched` is how many tools matched in total and `returned` is how many came back — when `truncated` is true there are more, so do not tell the user the catalog only contains what this page returned; raise `limit` (max 50) instead.

category.description: Restrict to one catalog category slug, e.g. 'video' or 'writing'.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'video editing', 'transcription', or a product name.

name: search_ai_tools
title: Search the AI tool catalog
